hook: Free K-pop fest in Hyderabad *today*: NTX live at Shilpakala Vedika
hook_b: The 'Tauba Tauba' K-pop band is in Hyderabad today. Entry is *free*
tldr: K-Harmony Festa, Korea Culture Day 2026, is on today at Shilpakala Vedika, Madhapur. Gates open at 1 pm, entry is free, and K-pop group NTX headlines alongside Korean food, K-beauty and Telangana folk acts.

beats.what: The Korean Cultural Centre India and the Telangana government host K-Harmony Festa today, Oct 25, at Shilpakala Vedika. Open to visitors from 1 pm; the opening ceremony is at 5:30 pm.
beats.why: It's Korea Culture Day 2026, themed 'One Light, Two Cities' (Seoul and Hyderabad), set up through an MoU with the state government.
beats.care: Free entry, so go early: popular K-pop events fill up fast. Check the Korean Cultural Centre India's social pages for exact show times.

cards.body: Line-up: NTX (known for their viral 'Tauba Tauba' cover), Daekyung Taekwondo, Atti Classic vocal crossover, Deeper instrumental, Ayuni classical, Eolssigu traditional performance, plus Telangana's Perini dance and Dappulu.

cards.title: what else is there?
cards.body: Korean food and coffee, K-beauty stalls, shopping, a flash mob, random dance play, Samulnori drumming, Taekwondo, and Telangana handicraft stalls.

cards.why: Shilpakala Vedika, Madhapur; open from 1 pm, entry free.

cover.label: K-pop fest at Shilpakala Vedika today

learn.t: Samulnori is a Korean percussion style played on four traditional instruments.

watch: Exact performance times on the Korean Cultural Centre India's social pages.
